name: desktop-fly-pet
description: Desktop fruit flies that land on icons, flee the cursor, eat, and can be swatted

scripts.start:annoy: node scripts/set-flavor.mjs annoy && electron . && node scripts/set-flavor.mjs breed
scripts.dist: node scripts/set-flavor.mjs breed && electron-builder --win -c.productName=果蝇乐园 -c.appId=com.desktopfly.pet
scripts.dist:annoy: node scripts/set-flavor.mjs annoy && electron-builder --win -c.productName=果蝇乐园造福版 -c.appId=com.desktopfly.welfare && node scripts/set-flavor.mjs breed

author: desktop-fly-pet
